name: Sexless - Jimi Tsuma ga Furin ni Hashitta Riyuu
original_name: セックスレス 地味妻が不倫に走った理由
source:
Mikami Riko is 34 years old and leads a sexless life. She is troubled by her husband Kiyoshi's reluctance to have sex at night.

On the other hand, Gotou Toshiaki has a beautiful wife 10 years younger than him.
He is also fed up with his sexless and loveless life.

One day, at a school reunion, Riko meets Toshiaki, whom she had a relationship with when they were students. When Riko and Toshiaki tell each other about their dissatisfaction with their married life, they quickly become friends and it finally becomes a physical relationship. Although she is aware that she is doing something wrong, the relationship continues.

Disappointed by her husband's lack of interest in having children, she soon awakens to a certain feeling.

"I want to have children of my own. If my husband doesn't want to have a baby, then..."

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013072.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
三上梨子今年34岁，过着无性生活。她对丈夫Kiyoshi不愿在晚上做爱感到困扰。

另一方面，后藤俊明有一个比他小10岁的美丽妻子。
他也厌倦了无性无爱的生活。

有一天，在一次同学聚会上，梨子遇见了她在学生时代就曾有过恋情的俊明。当梨子和俊明互相诉说自己对婚姻生活的不满时，他们很快就成为了朋友，并最终发展成为肉体关系。尽管她知道自己做错了事，但这种关系仍在继续。

她对丈夫对生孩子缺乏兴趣感到失望，很快就意识到了某种感觉。

“我想要自己的孩子，如果我丈夫不想生孩子，那……”
